description: Build a multi-panel macro market cockpit that combines FX sessions, upcoming release queue, pair context, and generated risk alerts. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency for pair context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Defaults to the release currency when omitted. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

currency.description: Release currency used for queue and spotlight indicator. Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

indicator.description: Spotlight indicator slug for release context. Supported examples: any indicator slug the FXMacroData catalogue lists for the currency, for example inflation, gdp, policy_rate, unemployment.

quote.description: Quote currency for pair context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: any lowercase 3-letter ISO code in the FXMacroData catalogue, for example usd, eur, gbp, jpy.

name: macro_war_room_task
